body.name: Candidate quantitative transfer remainder condition
body.construction:
The candidate numerical transfer condition \(\mathsf G_n\) consists of
\[
 n^{5/6}(\log n)^{3/2}\mathfrak B_n=o_P(1),\qquad
 \sqrt{\log n}\,\mathfrak R_n=o_P(1),\qquad
 (\log n)\mathfrak K_n=o_P(1),\qquad
 \left|\frac{\widehat{\mathcal V}_n}{\mathcal V(P)}-1\right|=o_P(1),
\]
each uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal M\). These scalar clauses record proposed product-bias, local empirical, variance-normalization, and clock accuracies. They do not by definition imply common contact localization, a slope envelope, optimized-value stability, or a Gumbel limit.
